I took my Doberman to Nanoussa Grooming for the very first time, and I am absolutely delighted with the experience.

My Doberman, who can sometimes be a little stressed in new environments, was put at ease very quickly, which was much appreciated.

The result is simply impeccable: a shiny, perfectly clean coat, a pleasant scent, and meticulous finishing touches. It's clear that the work is done with passion and attention to detail. My dog ​​left relaxed, happy, and even more handsome than before.

I wholeheartedly recommend Nanoussa Grooming to all owners looking for high-quality, attentive, and professional service. A first experience that was more than successful; I will definitely be back.
